addresses.name: CCombatView::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CCombatView::BuildTooltip(CCombatView* view, GuiTooltipText* out, void* element)
addresses.comment: Read whole. Reached for any element whose group (+8) is army_option, wing_option, navy_option or combat_view. combat_battle_events_icon, or the window's slot 17 for combat_event_name: nothing. combat_terrain the terrain's name; combat_width COMBAT_WIDTH; positioning FLEET_POSITIONING; retreat_button COMBAT_RETREAT. By kind: ships (0x727CD0), planes (0x72D100), or on land the attacker's committed (BuildUnitTooltip), its reserves (0x72BD70), the defender's committed and reserves (BuildUnitTooltip), then tactic_name/tactic_picture (CCombatTactic::BuildTooltip) and combat_attack_indicator. Every kind: leader_name/leader_photo the highest ranked leader's tooltip, LEADER_INITIATIVE in delayed where his skill is above the other side's. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-battletooltips.md.
addresses.revises: Read whole, inferred to confirmed; the routes in full, the dispatcher's test by group.
addresses.evidence: The dispatcher's tests at 0x6C5C5E..0x6C5CAC compare [edi+8]; the router decompiled whole.
